label: win (2-seed evidence)
note: Frontier +8/+14 (p=0.057 / 0.0026; Fisher 0.0015); best graded regret (1.98) and best unseen row (177/200); same direction on every exam at both seeds.
result: Before, the value network predicted an internal plan-step count. Now it predicts the real number of robot moves. It solved 177 of 200 new-board puzzles, the best of any single change, vs 172 unchanged. It was better on the hard exam in both training runs. The combined chance of luck is about 1 in 700. It also wasted the fewest moves of the whole program on the standard exam.
conclusion: Adopted. Train on the number you are graded on.
